svg.aria-label: 4 model-version pairs on one shared environment axis: one row per environment across the 45 environments at least one pair compares, in the fleet's shared order, and inside each row one thin sub-row per pair. A hollow dot marks the older version and a filled dot the newer, joined by a connector in that pair's colour, and an exact tie fuses the two into one mark. The legend names each pair and carries how many environments improved, tied and regressed. Claude Fable 5 -> Claude Fable 5.1: 45 environments both versions scored, newer ahead in 22, older in 9, 14 exact ties. GPT-5.6 Sol -> GPT-6 Astra: 45 environments both versions scored, newer ahead in 24, older in 5, 16 exact ties. DeepSeek V4 Pro -> DeepSeek V4.1 Flash: 41 environments both versions scored, newer ahead in 34, older in 4, 3 exact ties. Kuhn Poker (Adapted), Gem Mining (MOMAland), Item Gathering (MOMAland) scored by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash alone and excluded. Humanoid Standup (MuJoCo) scored by DeepSeek V4 Pro alone and excluded. Gemini 3.5 Flash -> Gemini 3.6 Flash: 41 environments both versions scored, newer ahead in 16, older in 15, 10 exact ties. Pong (Atari ALE with ARI), Multi Room (MiniGrid), Unlock Pickup (MiniGrid) scored by Gemini 3.6 Flash alone and excluded.
